works.title: OH
works.desc: A small grey cube-bodied robot on two slender articulated legs with pointed metal feet. It has a red status light on top, a red ring button on one side, and "OH" and "PROJECT 06" markings on its body. Modeled and rendered in Blender on a plain grey studio background.

works.title: Inferno
works.desc: A white humanoid robot with a rounded head, glowing blue visor-style eyes, a glowing circular light on its chest, black articulated joints, and brown boots. Modeled and rendered in Blender against a dark green studio background with soft shadows.

works.title: Swordfish Ship
works.desc: An anime-inspired sci-fi hover craft with a glossy red, weathered body, polished chrome cannon barrel, twin angled wing fins with propeller-style details, and an open cockpit canopy. Modeled and rendered in Blender, shown against a plain white studio background.

works.title: Robo 2.0
works.desc: A 3D render of Robo 2.0, a stylized robot character with a cardboard-box head, glowing pink eyes on a dark screen, black headphones, a grey hoodie with orange sleeves, navy pants, and white boots with pink laces, shown against a clean white studio background. Modeled and rendered in Blender.
